findings.suggested_fix: Reword: 'Given 21 doctors have a Saturday block and doctors without one sort between them by name, when ... choose "Saturday", then page 1 shows the first 20 Saturday doctors by name and page 2 the 21st.'
findings.text: Carried over from a1 F-5 and still unresolved. The S-6 AC1 Given ('a 21st doctor by name') does not say that 21 doctors have a Saturday block, or that doctors without one sort between them by name.

rubric_items.reason: All 15 known REQs are traced. REQ-7 now has ACs for search, department, specialization (new S-3 AC4) and status.
Each story has one outcome: column, filter, combination, page address, unchanged list, paging/count. Each has at most five ACs.

The Sunday ACs catch a wrong weekday coding, S-6 AC3 catches join duplicates and S-6 AC2 catches filtering after paging. The S-6 AC1 Given does not say how many doctors work Saturday or how they are ordered.
20 per page comes from REQ-8 and the 21st doctor is derived from it inline. The "Any status" label exists in the product's doctor list filter. Other values are test data.
Terms are consistent (Works on, Any day, front-desk staff). The S-6 AC1 Given is still awkwardly worded.
